text:
priya: quick sync — we need to lock sprint scope for Dedicated capacity (reserved pools + burst + autoscale). acme & beacon pushed for GA timelines. can we decide launch gating today? :hourglass:
mike: short question — are we committing to per-tenant reserved pools at GA or a simpler pool + priority lanes model?
priya: aiming for pool + priority lanes at GA (simpler billing + fewer infra changes). reserved per-tenant as follow-up. need to confirm burst rules & autoscale hysteresis.
anya: technical constraints: continuous batching + preemptible lanes are fine. biggest risk is KV cache warmup on spillover; that increases 95p latency until warm. we should define a prewarm window and a spillover grace period.
sam: from customers: ACME cares about deterministic tail latency (SLA), Beacon cares more about burst headroom during launches. both asked for explicit burst caps and transparent throttling behavior.
jen: sales note — contracts expecting a "burst guarantee" phrasing. we can offer a measured burst envelope but we must flag it as "best-effort" unless they buy Dedicated reserved headroom add-on.
priya: proposed launch checklist (draft):
- pool + priority lanes enabled
- burst envelope: per-pool soft-burst 4x baseline, 1h carryover cap
- autoscale: scale-up aggressive (1.5x/min), scale-down slow (hysteresis 15m)
- preempt policy: evict opportunistic after soft-burst, notify tenant via 429 + retry-after
- observability: per-tenant token-level latency + burst-metering
mike: implementation questions:
```yaml
autoscale:
  scale_up_rate: 1.5
  scale_down_cooldown: 900 # seconds
burst:
  soft_multiplier: 4
  carryover_hours: 1
```
anya: +1 to those defaults, but suggest we add a circuit-breaker: if 95p latency spikes > 2x baseline for 10m, automatically tighten burst to 2x and trigger rollback to previous model variant.
sam: customers want a clear escape hatch — can we include a "burst opt-out" flag for sensitive tenants so their traffic never uses opportunistic capacity?
priya: yes we should. opt-out => pinned reserved pool only (higher price). add to launch docs.
jen: need copy for contracts: "Burst envelope is a soft allowance meant to handle short-lived surges; sustained usage should be covered by reserved capacity or add-ons." i'll draft legal-friendly text.
deploy-bot: ticket CREATED: PROD-4621 "Dedicated: launch gating checklist + burst policy" assigned to @mike
mike: i'll take PROD-4621. timeline: can get basic pool+lanes + autoscale defaults in the next sprint, but circuit-breaker + carryover accounting needs an extra sprint.
priya: decision call — ship pool+lanes + burst envelope + opt-out at GA; treat circuit-breaker and per-tenant carryover accounting as GA+1. owners: mike (infra), anya (runtime), jen (contracts), sam (CS for comms). everyone OK?
anya: OK from runtime side.
sam: ok, i'll prepare customer comms template and flag ACME + Beacon for early validation.
jen: ok from sales/legal side, will sync contract language.
mike: ok — will update timeline on PROD-4621 and add subtask for circuit-breaker.
priya: thanks — i'll update the roadmap doc and mark launch criteria accordingly. follow-up sync 2pm PT. :calendar:
